preserves: source -> ingestion -> transformation -> storage -> calculation -> API -> display/export
a missing control is NOT_RUN/NOT_AVAILABLE, never PASS

candidate_rules.name: AS_OF_CUTOFF
candidate_rules.rule: For any observation used at target date T, source_date must be <= T unless the calculation explicitly models future information, which normal NAV/performance/benchmark/backtest paths do not.

candidate_rules.name: EXACT_THEN_PRIOR
candidate_rules.rule: For irregular market series, use exact date first; otherwise the latest valid observation strictly before or on target date within a declared tolerance. Never choose absolute-nearest across both sides of T.

candidate_rules.name: NO_FUTURE_FALLBACK
candidate_rules.rule: If no prior observation exists, return NULL/NOT_AVAILABLE or fail closed according to the consumer contract. Do not fall forward to the first future observation.

candidate_rules.name: NO_HARDCODED_MARKET_FALLBACK
candidate_rules.rule: A market FX/index value must not be silently replaced with a hardcoded approximate rate. Fixed legal parities such as EUR/XOF or EUR/XAF are explicit reference conventions, not fallback guesses.
candidate_rules.exception: Legally fixed parity must be versioned/documented as such.

candidate_rules.name: SOURCE_DATE_VISIBLE
candidate_rules.rule: New derived data contracts should expose source/effective date or sufficient lineage to reconstruct it, plus gap_days when a prior observation is carried forward.
candidate_rules.goal: Make stale-but-present data distinguishable from exact-date data.

candidate_rules.name: BACKTEST_AS_OF
candidate_rules.rule: Allocation/backtesting must slice every input by as_of date and must never reuse a helper that falls forward to future FX, benchmark or fund observations.

candidate_rules.name: CORRECTION_BEFORE_DERIVATION
candidate_rules.rule: When temporal contamination is corrected in source/benchmark fields, dependent ratios/relative analytics must be regenerated only after source correction and validated against unaffected outputs.
